name: Gentle Cheetah 21
author: Wendell47
description: Gradient rounded light cyan button that changes colour on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, background changes from linear-gradient(90deg, #de004b 0%, #bf46ff 49%, #00d4ff 100%) to #c1e4f8, text color changes from #252525 to #210055, width becomes 8rem.
